mentions.name: StoryStarling
mentions.description: This service creates custom hardcover children's books written from scratch around any idea, rather than swapping names into pre-set templates. It focuses on titles that are hard to find in bookstores, such as bilingual stories with parallel text and non-fiction books for kids with hyper-specific obsessions like tunnel boring machines or wastewater systems.
mentions.problem: Custom children's books typically just swap names into pre-set templates, and niche options like bilingual parallel-text stories or non-fiction on hyper-specific topics are not found in bookstores.
mentions.audience: Families in multilingual homes and kids with hyper-specific interests
mentions.source_excerpt:
I'm working on StoryStarling (https://www.storystarling.com). It creates custom hardcover children's books from scratch around any idea, instead of swapping names into pre-set templates.

We mostly focus on things you cannot find in bookstores: bilingual stories with parallel text for multilingual homes, and non-fiction for kids who have hyper-specific obsessions (like tunnel boring machines or wastewater systems).

mentions.name: storystarling
mentions.description: This web service creates personalized non-fiction children's books that explain any super-niche-geek topic to the customer's kid, who becomes the little explorer in the story. It illustrates the book and prints a physical copy; registration is required, but users can read the whole book before paying.
mentions.audience: Parents who want to explain their niche geek topics to their kids
mentions.source_excerpt: https://www.storystarling.com - create a non-fiction children's book explaining your super-niche-geek topic to your kid. Pick any topic, your kid becomes the little explorer, we illustrate and print it. Requires registration, but then lets you read the whole book before paying.
